stem: In the warehouse scenario, the agent must reason about a self-contained route constraint but also query a live inventory tool when stock information is missing. Which approach is best?

options.text: Use chain-of-thought for the self-contained constraint and interleave action when live evidence is needed
Use only a fixed action sequence
Use only a tool call without reasoning
Use debate indefinitely before any lookup
